**Pipeline controller notification**
This repo is configured to use the [pipeline controller](https://docs.ci.openshift.org/how-tos/creating-a-pipeline/). Second-stage tests will be triggered either automatically or after lgtm label is added, depending on the repository configuration. The pipeline controller will automatically detect which contexts are required and will utilize `/test` Prow commands to trigger the second stage.

For optional jobs, comment `/test ?` to see a list of all defined jobs. To trigger manually all jobs from second stage use `/pipeline required` command. 

This repository is configured in: LGTM mode

Skipping CI for Draft Pull Request.
If you want CI signal for your change, please convert it to an actual PR.
You can still manually trigger a test run with `/test all`

<details>

In response to [this](https://github.com/openshift/hypershift/pull/8633):

>## Summary
>
>- The runner image `COPY`s `contrib/ci/gocacheprog/` but the Tekton pipelines only triggered on `Dockerfile.github-actions-runner` changes
>- Adds `pathChanged()` for `contrib/ci/gocacheprog` and each pipeline's own YAML so the image rebuilds when either is updated
>- This will trigger the image rebuild that includes the atomic writes fix from #8624
>
>## Test plan
>
>- [ ] Konflux PR pipeline triggers on this PR (validates `.tekton/*.yaml` self-trigger)
>- [ ] After merge, push pipeline triggers and rebuilds the runner image
>

<details>
<summary>📝 Walkthrough</summary>

## Walkthrough

This PR updates trigger conditions in two Tekton pipeline manifests for the GitHub Actions runner image builds. The pull-request pipeline now re-triggers when either `Dockerfile.github-actions-runner`, `contrib/ci/gocacheprog`, or the pipeline definition itself (`.tekton/hypershift-gh-actions-runner-pull-request.yaml`) changes. Similarly, the push pipeline expands its trigger to include changes to `.tekton/hypershift-gh-actions-runner-push.yaml` while preserving the main branch constraint. Both changes ensure the pipelines validate themselves when their own configuration is modified.
